mapper.sql: SELECT t.id,t.owner_id,t.capacity_qty,t.remaining_slots,t.return_date FROM t_trips t JOIN t_profiles p ON p.id=t.owner_id WHERE t.id=#{id} AND t.status='active' AND t.visibility='public' AND t.verify_status='approved' AND t.return_date >= CURRENT_DATE() AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.carrier_verify_status='approved' AND (p.banned_until IS NULL OR p.banned_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM t_orders WHERE trip_id=#{trip} AND status NOT IN ('cancelled_no_fault','cancelled_breach','refunded','closed')
SELECT id,buyer_id,status,agreed_json FROM t_orders WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_categories c WHERE c.id=#{category} AND c.active=1 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_trip_categories tc WHERE tc.trip_id=#{trip}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_trip_categories tc WHERE tc.trip_id=#{trip} AND tc.category_id=c.id))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_orders(id,order_no,trip_id,buyer_id,vendor_id,source,item_name,item_spec,quantity,unit, expect_unit_price,goods_amount,service_fee,buyer_deposit,vendor_deposit,status,buyer_deposit_status,vendor_deposit_status, insured,insurance_premium,declared_value,contact_name,contact_phone,address,note,expect_arrive_date,intent_deadline,agreed_json, ref_image_urls,purchase_receipt_urls,cancel_proof_urls,purchase_evidence,freight_label_urls,ship_risk_flags,purchase_meta,purchase_risk_flags) VALUES(#{id},#{orderNo},#{input.tripId},#{buyer},#{vendor},'trip_intent',TRIM(#{input.itemName}),#{input.itemSpec},#{input.quantity},#{input.unit}, #{input.expectUnitPrice},#{price.goodsAmount},#{price.serviceFee},#{price.buyerEscrow},#{price.vendorDeposit},'requesting','frozen','unpaid', CASE WHEN #{input.insuranceChoice}='yes' THEN 'unselected' ELSE 'waived' END,#{price.insurancePremium},#{price.goodsAmount},#{input.contactName},#{input.contactPhone},#{input.address},#{input.note},#{input.expectDate}, TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,#{intentHours},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)),CAST(#{snapshot} AS JSON), JSON_ARRAY(),JSON_ARRAY(),JSON_ARRAY(),JSON_OBJECT(),JSON_ARRAY(),JSON_ARRAY(),JSON_OBJECT(),JSON_ARRAY())
